Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100696 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100696], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100696-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(65, 66, 674, 878)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>516d5409089767ba6cdb6213a282116a4f5cabccf3dbb932a9598d1b8b2adede</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
